page: Microsoft Azure DC8as_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCasv6 family. It is powered by an AMD processor built on the x86_64 architecture and operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration provisions 8 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, delivering a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no bundled GPU accelerators.

Storage configuration contains no local disks, meaning persistent and scratch data must rely entirely on remote storage, with the instance being Premium Storage capable. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Compute resources are strictly dedicated rather than shared or burstable, which ensures consistent execution without CPU credit throttling.

From an infrastructure perspective, the server offers balanced resource density suited for tasks that do not require bundled ephemeral disks. Workload fit includes web application hosting, business-tier microservices, CI/CD runners, and relational databases leveraging remote managed storage.
